jobs.title: Armed Driving Security Officer – Retail Mobile Patrol
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking an Armed Driver Mobile Response Security Officer in Austin, TX. You will provide customer service, conduct patrols, and respond to incidents while maintaining a strong safety presence at a retail location.

The role requires an armed certification, a valid driver’s license, and a high school diploma. This full-time position offers steady shifts, competitive pay, and opportunities to advance within a nationwide security team.
